description: A minimal React 18 SPA bundled with webpack 5 + @afterpack/webpack (real webpack.config using AfterpackWebpackPlugin). Proves the webpack bundle survives obfuscation: the page renders and the React useState counter interaction still works in chromium.

build.note: webpack bundles src/index.jsx -> dist/[name].[contenthash].js, obfuscated by @afterpack/webpack's processAssets tap, before webpack writes

interactions.description: Clicking the counter runs the obfuscated React useState bundle and re-renders.
